entries.title: DFE (FCN Base) - Dewarping Document Image By Displacement Flow Estimation with Fully Convolutional Network (2021)
entries.summary: The DFE model employs a fully convolutional network to estimate dense displacement flow fields, enabling accurate dewarping of document images and thus improving text recognition performance.

entries.title: DocTr - Document Image Transformer for Geometric Unwarping and Illumination Correction (2021)
entries.summary: DocTr introduces a transformer‑based architecture for geometric unwarping and illumination correction of document images, tackling typical issues in dewarped document processing.

entries.title: Rectinet - A Gated and Bifurcated Stacked U-Net Module for Document Image Dewarping (2020)
entries.summary: The study introduces RubricBasedQA, an automatically generated, criterion-referenced QA dataset that evaluates large language models using structured rubrics, facilitating consistent assessment of their reasoning abilities across multi-hop, compositional, and long-tailed examples.

entries.title: Multistage Curvilinear Coordinate Transform Based Document Image Dewarping using a Novel Quality Estimator (2020)
entries.summary: Proposes a multistage curvilinear coordinate transform with a novel quality estimator for dewarping document images, improving subsequent analysis tasks.

entries.title: 10. DewarpNet - Single-Image Document Unwarping With Stacked 3D and 2D Regression Networks (2019)
entries.summary: DewarpNet introduces a stacked 3D‑2D regression network that predicts per‑pixel warp maps to restore scanned document geometry, enabling precise text extraction and downstream analysis.

entries.title: Docuwarp (2019)
entries.summary: The paper introduces Docuwarp, a geometric dewarping method that corrects curved document photographs to recover flat page layouts, leading to improved document analysis accuracy.

entries.title: DocUNet: Document Image Unwarping via a Stacked U-Net (2018)
entries.summary: DocUNet introduces a stacked U-Net architecture that restores warped document images to a flat, legible form, thereby improving OCR performance on scanned texts.

entries.title: Robust Document Image Dewarping Method Using Text-Lines and Line Segments (2017)
entries.summary: We document the *Image Dewarping Dataset for Document Images* from the 2017 paper "Robust Document Image Dewarping Method Using Text-Lines and Line Segments" (2017). This dataset provides real-world paired distorted and corrected document images for quantitative evaluation of dewarping algorithms.

entries.title: Document dewarping via text-line based optimization (2015)
entries.summary: This paper presents a text-line based optimization method for dewarping document images, aligning and straightening warped pages to improve readability and downstream OCR performance.

entries.id: A novel model-based dewarping technique for advanced Digital Library systems (2014)
entries.title: A novel model-based dewarping technique for advanced Digital Library systems (2014)
entries.summary: The paper presents a model-based technique to dewarp photographs of bound books, correcting geometric distortions to enhance the quality of digitized documents in digital library applications.

entries.title: A Model-based Book Dewarping Method Using Text Line Detection (2007)
entries.summary: This 2007 study introduces a model-based dewarping technique that first detects text lines in book page images to correct geometric skew, thereby improving the accuracy of subsequent OCR processes.

entries.title: Dewarping of document image by global optimization (2005)
entries.summary: The paper presents a global optimization approach to correct geometric distortions in document images, improving dewarping accuracy through systematic image processing techniques.

entries.title: RectiNet-v2 - A stacked network architecture for document image dewarping
entries.summary: RectiNet-v2 presents a stacked deep learning architecture that rectifies and dewarps curved, warped document pages into flat, distortion-free images, improving the accuracy of downstream OCR tasks.

entries.title: TADoc: Robust Time-Aware Document Image Dewarping
entries.authors: Fangmin Zhao, Weichao Zeng, Zhenhang Li, Dongbao Yang, Yu Zhou
entries.summary: TADoc presents a robust, time-aware approach for dewarping document images captured under varying temporal conditions, preserving accurate text rendering and layout.

entries.title: OCRGenBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating OCR Generative Capabilities
entries.authors: Peirong Zhang, Haowei Xu, Jiaxin Zhang, Xuhan Zheng, Guitao Xu, Yuyi Zhang, Junle Liu, Zhenhua Yang, Wei Zhou, Lianwen Jin
entries.summary: OCRGenBench is a standardized benchmark that evaluates generative OCR capabilities using diverse synthetic patterns such as fonts, scanning distortions, and biometric scans. It test and OCR Consistency Evaluation Benchmarks

entries.title: Axis-Aligned Document Dewarping
entries.authors: Chaoyun Wang, I-Chao Shen, Takeo Igarashi, Caigui Jiang
entries.summary: This technique corrects axis-aligned warping distortions in scanned document images, restoring them to a rectangular shape to facilitate further processing such as OCR and analysis.

entries.title: D2Dewarp: Dual Dimensions Geometric Representation Learning Based Document Image Dewarping
entries.authors: Heng Li, Xiangping Wu, Qingcai Chen
entries.summary: The paper proposes D2Dewarp, a dual‑dimensional geometric representation learning framework that effectively dewarps document images, providing accurate geometric normalization for downstream layout analysis and OCR tasks.

entries.title: DvD: Unleashing a Generative Paradigm for Document Dewarping via Coordinates-based Diffusion Model
entries.authors: Weiguang Zhang, Huangcheng Lu, Maizhen Ning, Xiaowei Huang, Wei Wang, Kaizhu Huang, Qiufeng Wang
entries.summary: The paper introduces DvD, a generative diffusion model for document dewarping that operates directly on coordinate representations, achieving state-of-the-art performance. It leverages a novel generative paradigm to model dewarping transformations in coordinate space.

entries.title: Efficient Document Image Dewarping via Hybrid Deep Learning and Cubic Polynomial Geometry Restoration
entries.authors: Valery Istomin, Oleg Pereziabov, Ilya Afanasyev
entries.summary: The authors present a fast dewarping method that combines a convolutional neural network with cubic polynomial geometric modeling to accurately restore the original shape of warped document pages.

entries.title: Polar-Doc: One-Stage Document Dewarping with Multi-Scope Constraints under Polar Representation
entries.authors: Weiguang Zhang, Qiufeng Wang, Kaizhu Huang
entries.summary: The authors introduce Polar-Doc, a single-stage deep learning framework that leverages polar coordinates and multi-scope constraints to dewarp curved document images captured under polar representation. This approach improves dewarping accuracy and robustness for document imaging tasks.

entries.title: MataDoc: Margin and Text Aware Document Dewarping for Arbitrary Boundary
entries.authors: Beiya Dai, Xing li, Qunyi Xie, Yulin Li, Xiameng Qin, Chengquan Zhang, Kun Yao, Junyu Han
entries.summary: MataDoc introduces a margin- and text-aware dewarping approach that enhances geometric accuracy and readability for documents with arbitrary boundaries.

entries.title: Marior: Margin Removal and Iterative Content Rectification for Document Dewarping in the Wild
entries.authors: Jiaxin Zhang, Canjie Luo, Lianwen Jin, Fengjun Guo, Kai Ding
entries.summary: The paper introduces Marior, a method that removes document margins and iteratively refines warped content to correct distortions, enabling robust dewarping under uncontrolled imaging conditions.

entries.authors: Xiangwei Jiang, Rujiao Long, Nan Xue, Zhibo Yang, Cong Yao, Gui-Song Xia
entries.summary: This paper revisits document image dewarping by proposing a grid regularization technique to correct geometric distortions in scanned documents.
